title: Adopt the 30-day focus
question: Should we adopt the CEO's recommended 30-day plan?
context: From the 3 September executive meeting on what to focus on over the next 30 days. Seated the CMO, CPO and Head of FPL Analytics. Days 1-4 clear the ground (accuracy figures state their population, remove the Premium gate, drop the unbacktested score, fix the README); days 4-14 SEO and analytics live before the GW5 deadline on 18 September; then observe through the three-week international break and read the data at GW6. The CPO dissented on ordering and that dissent is on the record with a reopening trigger.
